title: Liverpool City Region Combined Authority – AI Summit
summary: Liverpool's 2024 AI Summit planned interactive digital humans to assist attendees and host proceedings. Easier access to event information remains an intended benefit without a measured outcome.
account: The Combined Authority announced that multilingual, interactive digital humans would serve as concierges and masters of ceremonies at its November 21, 2024 AI Summit. Supplier Sum Vivas separately identified Ava, Alison, and James as AI-integrated digital humans that delegates could engage with at the event. Their intended role was to assist visitors and support event delivery. The sources do not measure whether attendees found information more easily, whether language barriers fell, or whether organizers saved time. The record concerns this specific use of AI, without attributing the summit's investment interest or attendance to the concierges.
purpose: Help summit attendees access information through multilingual AI interaction and support event hosting.
system: Sum Vivas AI-integrated digital humans Ava, Alison, and James
deployer: Liverpool City Region Combined Authority and Sum Vivas

ratings.reason: Attendees are intended to receive assistance through multilingual AI concierges. The sources do not establish the extent of any improvement in access to event information or visitor experience.
Organizers are intended to receive support with visitor assistance and hosting. No operational saving or service improvement attributable to the digital humans is measured.

ai_role.statement: The organizer and supplier identify interactive AI digital humans with concierge and hosting functions. The 2024 announcements establish a specific intended application, without evaluating its contribution to visitor or organizer outcomes.

evidence.citation: Liverpool City Region Combined Authority, November 19, 2024. Organizer announcement for the November 21 summit.
evidence.title: From medicine to education, industry and science: digital humans to introduce inspiring vision of future at international AI Summit

evidence.citation: Sum Vivas, announcement of its participation in the November 21, 2024 summit. The retrieved page does not display an exact publication date.

produced_by: The planned service uses multilingual, interactive AI digital humans to assist attendees and host proceedings.
must_hold: The assistants would need accurate event information, usable interaction, and appropriate language support. These are practical requirements inferred from the service, not validated conditions sufficient to reproduce a benefit.

headline: Liverpool plans multilingual AI concierges for summit attendees

revisions.change: Added the specific intended AI application after reviewing project documentation beyond the collection entry. Benefit depth and outcome status remain separate from the evidence confidence.

claim_basis: The makers' report and two reports from the deployer are on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
